verdict.rationale: Square documents a full Webhooks system with subscription setup (square-docs-19), signature verification (square-docs-20), and event logs in the dashboard/devtools (square-supp-api-explorer), giving programmatic subscribe-to-events capability usable by AI-native integrations via SDKs/MCP. Missing for 10: no explicit example of an AI agent directly managing webhook subscriptions via the MCP server, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
